gapNote: Several search results give conflicting parentage (one biography portal names two mothers; Madame Tussauds Berlin names a Tunisian mother and Algerian father). Those were not fetched or used. The fetched press pieces (earlygame, serienjunkies) and the German Wikipedia lead agree on a Tunisian father and Austrian mother, so the page states that with citations. Net worth is not sourced by any named estimate, so it is left out. Private-life search queries (wife, partner, children, separation, religion) are not answered. The Virginia Woolf's Night & Day release date differs by country (German cinema listing 9 July 2026; BBFC lists UK release 19/06/2026 but was not used). The page is useful because it pulls the 2026 films into one timeline with dates from sources that were actually opened.
